law: For N zero-dead-time uniformly sampled fractional-frequency observations y, positive integer m and N >= 3m, average each m-point contiguous block: a_i=(1/m)*sum(y[i:i+m]); compute the mean squared second difference of consecutive m-block averages divided by 6, over all i=0..N-3m. Return exact rational variance when inputs are exact rational. Reject invalid m or insufficient data.
time_contract: Assumes equal input sample period tau0 with zero dead-time; reported averaging time tau=m*tau0, not wall-clock timezone or UTC.

positive_witnesses.explanation: block means 0,1,0; m=2 reflects averaging time
linear frequency drift annihilated by second differences

falsifiers: Use the Allan first-difference estimator instead of the Hadamard second-difference estimator: a linear frequency drift becomes nonzero, violating the contract.
Normalize by 2 instead of 6, or silently use sample variance N-1; the 3-sample impulse must equal exactly 1/6.
Allow m=0, negative/non-integer m, N<3*m or silently fill missing samples; valid samples must be uniformly timed with no dead-time.
Conflate the HVAR finite nonoverlapping/overlapping convention or claim a different confidence estimator (modified or total Hadamard) is the same statistic.

dedup.nearest_pending_peer: ALLAN-VARIANCE in #4909, not to be reselected or relabeled
dedup.behavioral_difference: Allan differences y[i+1]-y[i], while Hadamard uses three-frequency second differences y[i]-2*y[i+m]+y[i+2*m], suppressing linear frequency drift.
dedup.core_minimality: The statistic is an ordinary composite of exact arithmetic, finite sequences and summation; even with distinctive semantics it may belong in a SENS math library instead of occupying D10. Owner review required, not guaranteed irreducible primitive.
dedup.d2_control_scope: No syntax, control flow, scheduler, host clock reading, or binary transport.
